principles: Wingspan only adds what Monarch doesn't do yet. Most features add to a Monarch page you already use.
If Monarch has only planned or started a feature, Wingspan can still build it, since plans can change.
When Monarch releases a matching feature, Wingspan deprecates and removes its own.
A full match means Wingspan's version goes once Monarch's ships. A partial match means Monarch's covers some of it, so Wingspan's gets another look then.
Wingspan never rebuilds or unlocks what Monarch already has, paid plans included.

items.name: Projected balances
items.description: Your checking balance day by day, so you see a low point coming, plus your monthly surplus

cards.note: Monarch moved this to Up next in October 2026.
Monarch's forecasting looks years ahead. Projected balances looks up to a year ahead, day by day.

items.name: Month-end projection
items.description: This month's income and expense bars extended to where the month is headed, bills still due included

items.name: Spending averages

items.description: A category's 3-month, 12-month and year-to-date averages on Budget, and its average per month on its own page

items.name: Expected income
items.description: Income that changes week to week, like client payouts, counted at what you usually take in

items.name: Loans paid down
items.where: Adds to Cash Flow and Reports
items.description: How much your loans went down and what share of income that is, beside Monarch's savings rate

items.name: Interest cost
items.where: Adds to Cash Flow, Reports and Accounts
items.description: What your loans and carried card balances cost in interest a day, a month and a year

items.name: Loan balance updates

items.description: An estimated new balance to save on a loan you track by hand, once the payment you linked on Recurring posts

items.name: HSA reimbursements

items.description: Medical expenses you paid yourself and can still pay back from your HSA, with any missing receipts flagged

items.description: How much of each budget row was paid from your HSA, so medical bills don't read as overspending

items.name: Order items

cards.note: Monarch filters by business one page at a time, and the choice resets in a new tab.

items.name: Sidebar items
items.description: Hide any item in Monarch's sidebar you don't use

items.name: Pay periods
items.description: Your month split by paycheck: the bills due before each one and what's left to spend until the next

items.name: Running balance
items.description: An account's balance after each transaction, like a checkbook register

items.name: Custom recurring frequency

items.name: Recurring by owner

items.name: Refunds owed

items.name: Free cash on the Dashboard

items.name: Easier bill setup
